# ServiceTitan & GoHighLevel Integration Architecture & Data Flow Specification
**Client:** Apex Comfort Solutions (Chris Koehne) | Central Texas HVAC  
**Target Impact:** Recover $37,500/mo ($450,000/yr) revenue leakage  
**Core Systems:** ServiceTitan (v2 API), GoHighLevel (v2 SaaS Engine), Google LSA, Twilio/GHL LC-Phone  

---

## 1. Technical Architecture & End-to-End Data Flow

The following architecture eliminates the manual Google Sheets data entry bottleneck, guarantees sub-5-minute speed-to-lead via automated missed-call text-back, and establishes a closed-loop quote re-engagement pipeline.

### 1.1 Integration Topology & System Boundaries

```
[ INBOUND CHANNELS ]
  ├── Google Local Services Ads (Direct Call / Message Lead)
  ├── Twilio / GHL LC-Phone Pool (After-Hours DNI Numbers)
  └── Web Inquiries (WordPress/Elementor Emergency Forms)
                               │
                               ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   GOHIGHLEVEL (SPEED-TO-LEAD & CRM)                     │
│  - Instant Missed-Call Text-Back Engine (Twilio/LC-Phone)              │
│  - 24/7 Interactive Conversational SMS AI / Speed-to-Lead Workflows   │
│  - Quote Nurture Sequences (Email/SMS)                                 │
│  - Local Lead Deduplication (E.164 Phone Normalization)                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                               │ 
        Outbound Webhook       │ Inbound Webhook / ST Poller
        (HMAC-SHA256 Signed)   │ (OAuth 2.0 JWT Bearer Token)
                               ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│             REVOPS INTEGRATION ENGINE (Middleware / Worker)            │
│  - Payload Validation & Schema Transformation                          │
│  - Customer & Location Deduplication Engine                            │
│  - Idempotency Cache (Redis TTL 86400s)                                │
│  - ServiceTitan v2 OAuth 2.0 Token Manager (Auto-Refresh)              │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                               │
                               ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   SERVICETITAN ENTERPRISE (SYSTEM OF RECORD)           │
│  - /jpm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/bookings  (Unassigned Booking Queue)      │
│  - /crm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/customers (Master Customer Record)        │
│  - /crm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/locations (Service Location Record)       │
│  - /accounting/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/estimates (Estimate Lifecycle)    │
│  - /telecom/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/calls (Call Attribution Records)      │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 1.2 Bidirectional Lifecycle State Machine

```
   [ Customer Initiates Contact ] 
                │
                ├── Missed Call (After-Hours) ──► GHL: Missed-Call Text-Back (< 30s)
                │                                    │
                └── Web Form / LSA Lead ────────────► GHL: Instant SMS Speed-to-Lead (< 60s)
                                                     │
                                                     ▼
                                        [ Prospect Responds via SMS ]
                                                     │
               ┌─────────────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────┐
               ▼                                                                           ▼
   [ Needs Booking / Emergency ]                                                [ Simple Inquiry / Out of Zone ]
               │                                                                           │
   GHL Workflow: Add Tag `st-sync-pending`                                      GHL: FAQ/Routing Sequence
               │
   POST Webhook to Middleware 
               │
   Middleware: ST Customer Match & Deduplication
     ├── If Match: Fetch `customerId` & `locationId`
     └── If No Match: `POST /crm/v2/.../customers` + `/locations`
               │
   `POST /jpm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/bookings`
     (Status: Open | Summary: Service Requested | Source: GHL/LSA)
               │
   Dispatcher receives booking directly inside ServiceTitan Dispatch Board.
   (Google Sheets intermediary completely bypassed)
               │
   Dispatcher Dispatches Tech ──► Tech Completes Diagnostic ──► Tech Presents Estimate
                                                                           │
                                                                           ▼
                                                             Estimate Generated in ST
                                                               (Status: Open / Unsold)
                                                                           │
                                          ┌────────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────┐
                                          ▼                                                               ▼
                               [ Customer Signs On-Site ]                                    [ Customer Does Not Sign ]
                                          │                                                               │
                                  ST: Estimate "Sold"                                           ST: Estimate "Open"
                                          │                                                               │
                                  ST Webhook / Poller:                                          ST Webhook / Poller:
                                  Status = Sold                                                 Status = Open (> 24 hrs)
                                          │                                                               │
                                          ▼                                                               ▼
                              GHL: Terminate Nurture Sequence                           GHL: Trigger Quote Nurture Sequence
                              Update Opportunity: "Won"                                 SMS/Email Drips (Day 1, 3, 5, 7)
                                                                                                          │
                                                                                        Prospect Accepts via GHL Link/Reply
                                                                                                          │
                                                                                                          ▼
                                                                                                Dispatcher Notified in ST
```

## 2. Master Data Dictionary & Field Mapping Table

### 2.1 Entity: Customer & Location (Contact Level)

| GoHighLevel Field Key | GHL Data Type | ServiceTitan Field Name | ST API Field Path (v2) | Direction | Business Rules / Transformation Logic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contact.id` | String | External ID / Note | `customer.externalId` | GHL ➔ ST | GHL unique identifier mapped to ST external ID for cross-system indexing. |
| `contact.first_name` | String | First Name | `customer.firstName` | GHL ➔ ST | Trim leading/trailing whitespace. Capitalize first letter. |
| `contact.last_name` | String | Last Name | `customer.lastName` | GHL ➔ ST | Fallback to "Homeowner" if empty on web-inquiry. |
| `contact.phone` | String (E.164) | Mobile Phone | `customer.mobilePhone` / `contacts.value` | Bidirectional | Sanitize to E.164 standard (`+1XXXXXXXXXX`). Must match regex `^\+1[2-9]\d{9}$`. |
| `contact.email` | String | Email | `customer.email` / `contacts.value` | Bidirectional | Lowercase normalization; format validation against standard RFC 5322. |
| `contact.address1` | String | Street Address | `location.address.street` | GHL ➔ ST | Street address for dispatch. |
| `contact.city` | String | City | `location.address.city` | GHL ➔ ST | Validated against Apex Comfort Solutions Central TX coverage zone. |
| `contact.state` | String | State | `location.address.state` | GHL ➔ ST | Default to `TX`. Must be 2-letter uppercase ISO. |
| `contact.postal_code` | String | Zip Code | `location.address.zip` | GHL ➔ ST | Clean to 5-digit ZIP format. |
| `custom_fields.st_customer_id` | String | Customer ID | `customer.id` | ST ➔ GHL | ServiceTitan Customer ID; cached to bypass duplicate lookup queries. |
| `custom_fields.st_location_id` | String | Location ID | `location.id` | ST ➔ GHL | ServiceTitan Location ID associated with the physical service property. |

### 2.2 Entity: Booking & Job Scheduling (Transaction Level)

| GoHighLevel Field Key | GHL Data Type | ServiceTitan Field Name | ST API Field Path (v2) | Direction | Business Rules / Transformation Logic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `opportunity.id` | String | External Booking ID | `booking.externalId` | GHL ➔ ST | Prevents duplicate bookings via idempotency hashing. |
| `opportunity.name` | String | Summary | `booking.summary` | GHL ➔ ST | Format: `[Lead Source] - [Job Type] - [Last Name]`. |
| `custom_fields.job_type` | Dropdown | Job Type ID | `booking.jobTypeId` | GHL ➔ ST | Map to ST IDs: `Heating Repair`, `AC Emergency`, `System Replacement`. |
| `custom_fields.business_unit`| Dropdown | Business Unit ID | `booking.businessUnitId`| GHL ➔ ST | Central TX BU IDs: `101 (HVAC Service)`, `102 (HVAC Install)`. |
| `custom_fields.lead_source` | Dropdown | Campaign ID | `booking.campaignId` | GHL ➔ ST | Maps GHL source (`Google LSA`, `Website Emergency Form`, `Inbound Call`). |
| `custom_fields.priority_flag`| Dropdown | Priority | `booking.priority` | GHL ➔ ST | Values: `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Urgent`. (After-hours sets `Urgent`). |
| `custom_fields.technician_id`| String | Assigned Tech | `job.assignedTechnicianIds`| ST ➔ GHL | Populated when dispatcher assigns job in ST; sent back to notify prospect. |
| `custom_fields.scheduled_start`| ISO8601 | Start Time | `booking.start` | Bidirectional | UTC ISO8601 string. Converted to US/Central for local customer alerts. |

### 2.3 Entity: Quotes & Estimates (Revenue Leakage Recovery)

| GoHighLevel Field Key | GHL Data Type | ServiceTitan Field Name | ST API Field Path (v2) | Direction | Business Rules / Transformation Logic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `custom_fields.st_estimate_id`| String | Estimate ID | `estimate.id` | ST ➔ GHL | Primary lookup key for estimate tracking and status reconciliation. |
| `custom_fields.st_job_id` | String | Job ID | `estimate.jobId` | ST ➔ GHL | Links estimate directly to parent job record in ServiceTitan. |
| `opportunity.monetary_value` | Currency | Total Amount | `estimate.total` | ST ➔ GHL | Total estimate value in USD. Triggers high-ticket workflows if > $5,000. |
| `opportunity.stage` | Pipeline Stage | Estimate Status | `estimate.status` | ST ➔ GHL | ST Status: `Open` ➔ GHL: `Quote Delivered`; `Sold` ➔ `Won`; `Dismissed` ➔ `Lost`. |
| `custom_fields.estimate_summary`| String | Summary / Line Items | `estimate.summary` | ST ➔ GHL | High-level scope of work (e.g., "Full 16 SEER Heat Pump Replacement"). |
| `custom_fields.estimate_created`| ISO8601 | Created On | `estimate.createdOn` | ST ➔ GHL | Starts 24-hour countdown trigger for GHL Follow-Up Workflow. |

## 4. Edge Cases, Deduplication, and System Reliability Architecture

```
                 [ Incoming Payload: Raw Lead Data ]
                                 │
                                 ▼
                     [ Normalize Phone to E.164 ]
                                 │
                                 ▼
                   [ Check Idempotency Key in Redis ]
                      (Key: event_type + hash)
                                 │
                ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐
                ▼                                 ▼
         [ Key Exists ]                   [ Key Does Not Exist ]
                │                                 │
        [ Return 200 OK ]                 [ Store Key TTL 24h ]
       (Duplicate Ignored)                        │
                                                  ▼
                                     [ Query ST Customer API ]
                                       GET /crm/v2/.../customers
                                        ?phone={normalized_phone}
                                                  │
                                 ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐
                                 ▼                                 ▼
                          [ Record Found ]                 [ Record Not Found ]
                                 │                                 │
                          Extract ST IDs:                   Execute POST:
                          - customerId                      /crm/v2/.../customers
                          - locationId                      /crm/v2/.../locations
                                 │                                 │
                                 └────────────────┬────────────────┘
                                                  ▼
                                       [ Create Booking Record ]
                                      POST /jpm/v2/.../bookings
                                                  │
                                 ┌────────────────┴────────────────┐
                                 ▼                                 ▼
                            [ HTTP 200/201 ]                [ HTTP 4xx / 5xx ]
                                 │                                 │
                         [ Trigger GHL Tag: ]              [ Dead-Letter Queue ]
                         "st-booking-synced"               Exponential Backoff
                                                           (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h)
                                                                   │
                                                                   ▼
                                                          Alert Chris / Dispatch
                                                            via SMS & SaneBox
```

### 4.1 Deduplication & Address Normalization Logic
1. **Phone Match**: Clean inbound phone strings to standard 10-digit/E.164 format. Execute a lookup query against ServiceTitan's `/crm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/customers?phone={phone}`.
2. **Address Match**: If phone fails or returns multiple entries (e.g., landlord managing multiple properties), evaluate `streetAddress` and `zipCode` against `/crm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/locations`.
3. **Record Reuse**: When match exists, inherit `customerId` and `locationId` to construct bookings, strictly preventing duplicate account creation.

### 4.2 Idempotency & Concurrency Controls
* **Deduplication Key**: Generated using an HMAC-SHA256 hash derived from `phone + lead_source + calendar_date`.
* **State Verification**: Cached in memory for 24 hours. Prevents rapid-fire web-form clicks or carrier retries from generating duplicate ServiceTitan bookings.

### 4.3 Fault Tolerance & Rate Limiting Strategy
* **Rate Limits**: ServiceTitan V2 API enforces strict throughput constraints (typically 60 calls/minute per tenant for general endpoints). All outbound requests route through an asynchronous leaky-bucket queue.
* **Error Handling & Retry Mechanics**:
  * **HTTP 429 / 5xx**: Exponential backoff applied automatically at intervals of $t = 1\text{m}, 5\text{m}, 15\text{m}, 60\text{m}$.
  * **HTTP 400 (Bad Data)**: Transaction routes directly to a Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ).
  * **Dispatcher Alerting**: If DLQ depth exceeds zero, dispatch is immediately notified via automated SMS and SaneBox-routed high-priority email alert to Chris Koehne, ensuring customer calls are never lost.

# GoHighLevel 24/7 Speed-to-Lead & Missed-Call Automation Engine
**Client:** Apex Comfort Solutions (Chris Koehne) | Central Texas HVAC  
**Target Impact:** Eliminate response lag (from 2–4 hours down to <60 seconds) and recapture $22,500/month in lost after-hours emergency calls.  
**Tech Stack:** GoHighLevel (LC-Phone / Twilio), Google LSA Direct Connect, ServiceTitan v2 API Integration Layer.

---

## 1. Global System Configuration & Custom Architecture

Before deploying workflows, the GoHighLevel sub-account must be configured with standard parameters to ensure strict data hygiene, carrier compliance, and seamless downstream handoff to ServiceTitan.

### 1.1 Custom Fields & Custom Values

#### Custom Fields (Contact Level)
* `hvac_system_type` (Single Select): `AC / Cooling`, `Heat Pump / Heating`, `Dual Fuel`, `Ductless Mini-Split`, `Unknown`
* `urgency_level` (Single Select): `Critical Emergency (No Cooling/Heating)`, `Same-Day Priority`, `Standard Routine Repair`, `Estimate / Replacement Consultation`
* `emergency_risk_flag` (Multi-Select): `Vulnerable Occupant (Infant/Elderly)`, `Burning/Electrical Odor`, `Active Water Leak/Ceiling Collapse Risk`, `Complete System Outage (Temp > 90° or < 40°)`
* `homeowner_status` (Single Select): `Owns Home`, `Renting / Tenant`, `Property Manager`
* `service_address_validated` (Radio): `Yes`, `No`
* `preferred_time_window` (Single Select): `Immediately (Emergency)`, `First Available Morning (8am-12pm)`, `Afternoon (12pm-5pm)`
* `last_inbound_source` (Text): Populated via tracking numbers (`Google LSA Voice`, `Google LSA Message`, `Website Emergency Form`, `Main Inbound Pool`)

#### Custom Values (Location Level)
* `{{custom_values.company_name}}`: `Apex Comfort Solutions`
* `{{custom_values.business_hours_start}}`: `07:30` (US/Central)
* `{{custom_values.business_hours_end}}`: `18:00` (US/Central)
* `{{custom_values.dispatch_desk_phone}}`: Central Dispatch Direct Line
* `{{custom_values.tech_on_call_tier1}}`: E.164 phone of primary on-call technician
* `{{custom_values.tech_on_call_tier2}}`: E.164 phone of secondary/backup lead technician
* `{{custom_values.owner_emergency_escalation}}`: Chris Koehne direct mobile (E.164)
* `{{custom_values.service_area_zips}}`: List of serviceable Central Texas ZIP codes (Austin Metro, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Leander, Buda, Kyle)

### 1.2 Tag Taxonomy
* `lead-source:lsa-call`, `lead-source:lsa-msg`, `lead-source:web-form`, `lead-source:inbound-call`
* `status:mctb-active`, `status:triage-in-progress`, `status:qualified-emergency`, `status:qualified-routine`
* `dispatch:pending-tech-ack`, `dispatch:tech-assigned`, `dispatch:escalated-to-owner`
* `routing:out-of-service-area`, `routing:tenant-not-homeowner`
* `st-sync-pending`, `st-booking-synced`
* `bot-active`, `human-takeover`

---

## 2. GHL Workflow Buildout Specifications

```
                           [ INBOUND TOUCHPOINT ]
                                     │
           ┌─────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────┐
           ▼                                                   ▼
   [ Voice Call Unanswered ]                          [ Inbound Digital Lead ]
   (Google LSA / LC-Phone)                            (Web Form / LSA Message)
           │                                                   │
           ▼                                                   ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐                   ┌──────────────────────────────┐
│  WORKFLOW 1: Missed-Call     │                   │  WORKFLOW 2: Digital Speed-  │
│  Text-Back (MCTB) Engine     │                   │  to-Lead Engine              │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘                   └──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │                                                  │
               └───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
                                       │
                                       ▼
                       ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                       │  WORKFLOW 3: Conversational  │
                       │  SMS Triage & Qualification  │
                       └──────────────┬───────────────┘
                                       │
               ┌───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐
               ▼                                               ▼
       [ Critical Emergency ]                          [ Routine Service ]
               │                                               │
               ▼                                               ▼
┌──────────────────────────────┐                   ┌──────────────────────────────┐
│  WORKFLOW 4: On-Call Tech    │                   │  Direct Sync to ServiceTitan │
│  Escalation Protocol         │                   │  Standard Dispatch Queue     │
└──────────────────────────────┘                   └──────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Workflow 1: Missed-Call Text-Back (MCTB) & Call Routing Engine

#### Settings
* **Auto-Mark as Read:** Disabled (Dispatcher visibility required)
* **Allow Re-entry:** Enabled (Re-entry condition: After 15 minutes)
* **Stop on Response:** Yes (Conversational handoff to Workflow 3 upon prospect reply)

```
[ TRIGGER: Call Status = 'No-Answer', 'Busy', or 'Voicemail' ]
   Direction = Inbound | Tracking Numbers: [ All Apex Pools ]
        │
        ▼
[ ACTION: Add Contact Tag: status:mctb-active ]
        │
        ▼
[ CONDITION / IF-ELSE: Time of Call Evaluation ]
        ├── Branch A: Business Hours (Mon-Fri 07:30 - 18:00 CT | Sat 08:00 - 14:00 CT)
        └── Branch B: After-Hours / Weekend Emergency (Default / None)
```

#### Branch A: Business Hours Execution
1. **Wait Action:** Delay exactly `15 seconds` (Prevents bot-like instant ping before caller lowers phone).
2. **Action - Outbound SMS:** Send `SMS-MCTB-01-BIZ` via tracked caller ID.
3. **Action - Internal Alert:** In-App Notification & Desktop chime to Central Dispatch: *"Missed call from `{{contact.phone}}`. Business hours MCTB dispatched. Monitor for incoming reply."*
4. **Action - Pipeline Stage Update:** Move to Pipeline `HVAC Inbound Triage` -> Stage: `Missed Call - Pending Reply`.

#### Branch B: After-Hours / Critical Window Execution
1. **Wait Action:** Delay exactly `10 seconds`.
2. **Action - Outbound SMS:** Send `SMS-MCTB-02-AFTERHOURS` emphasizing immediate 24/7 HVAC rescue.
3. **Action - Pipeline Stage Update:** Move to Pipeline `HVAC Inbound Triage` -> Stage: `After-Hours Lead - Contact Attempted`.
4. **Action - Wait for Trigger:** Wait 3 minutes for Contact Reply.
   * *If no response after 3 minutes:* Send `SMS-MCTB-03-NUDGE`.
   * *If contact replies at any time:* Advance to **Workflow 3: Conversational Triage**.

---

### Workflow 2: High-Intent Digital Speed-to-Lead Auto-Responder

#### Settings
* **Triggers:**
  * Trigger 1: Inbound Web Form Submitted (Form ID: `apex_emergency_form`, `apex_contact_general`)
  * Trigger 2: Google LSA Message Lead Received (Channel: `Google Business Profile / LSA`)
* **Execution Window:** Run 24/7/365 without delay. Target SLA: Execution under 30 seconds.

```
[ TRIGGER: Web Form / Google LSA Message Inbound ]
        │
        ▼
[ ACTION: Standardize Phone Number to E.164 ]
        │
        ▼
[ ACTION: Apply Tags: lead-source:[source], bot-active ]
        │
        ▼
[ CONDITION: System Urgency Stated in Form? ]
        ├── Branch A: Form Selected "Emergency / Complete Outage"
        └── Branch B: Standard Repair / Quote / Maintenance
```

#### Branch A: Emergency Path
1. **Wait Action:** Delay `20 seconds`.
2. **Action - Outbound SMS:** Send `SMS-LEAD-01-EMERGENCY`.
3. **Action - Internal Voice Notification (Whisper Drop):** Place automated outbound call to On-Call Tech pool. Whisper: *"Urgent web intake from `{{contact.first_name}}` in `{{contact.city}}`. Immediate response needed."*
4. **Action - ServiceTitan Sync Gate:** Add Tag `st-sync-pending` to trigger downstream Middleware webhook.

#### Branch B: Standard Repair / Inactive Heating/Cooling
1. **Wait Action:** Delay `45 seconds`.
2. **Action - Outbound SMS:** Send `SMS-LEAD-02-STANDARD`.
3. **Action - Route to Workflow 3:** Monitor for qualification replies.

---

### Workflow 3: Conversational SMS Triage & Qualification Engine

This workflow parses the incoming prospect replies, distinguishes high-margin/urgent emergency calls from routine maintenance, validates geographic coverage, and packages the data for ServiceTitan job creation.

#### Settings
* **Trigger:** Customer Replied (Channel: SMS)
* **Pre-condition:** Contact has tag `bot-active` AND Contact does NOT have tag `human-takeover`.

#### Conversational State Machine Logic

```
                    [ Customer Sends Incoming SMS ]
                                  │
                                  ▼
                    [ Contains STOP/UNSUBSCRIBE? ]
                       ├── YES ──► [ Standard Opt-Out Protocol ]
                       └── NO
                                  │
                                  ▼
                   [ Check Current Lead Status Tag ]
                                  │
      ┌───────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────┐
      ▼                           ▼                           ▼
[ Has: status:mctb-active ]   [ Has: triage:step-1-pending ]  [ Has: triage:step-2-pending ]
(First response to bot)       (Evaluating issue details)      (Evaluating location/address)
```

#### Step 1: Initial Intent Classification
The bot assesses the initial message using intent keyphrase matching:

* **Intent Group: Emergency (`intent:emergency`)**
  * *Keywords/Phrases:* `not cooling`, `no ac`, `no heat`, `freezing`, `burning`, `smoke`, `leaking water`, `100 degrees`, `baby`, `elderly`, `emergency`, `stop working`, `blowing warm`, `sweating`, `tonight`, `now`.
  * *Actions:*
    1. Apply Tag: `status:qualified-emergency`.
    2. Set Custom Field: `urgency_level` = `Critical Emergency (No Cooling/Heating)`.
    3. Send Template: `SMS-TRIAGE-EMERGENCY-ACK`.
    4. Apply Tag: `triage:step-2-pending`.
    5. Remove Tag: `status:mctb-active`.

* **Intent Group: Routine Repair / Quote (`intent:routine`)**
  * *Keywords/Phrases:* `tune-up`, `maintenance`, `estimate`, `quote`, `system replacement`, `new unit`, `price`, `checkup`, `service call`, `next week`, `filter`.
  * *Actions:*
    1. Apply Tag: `status:qualified-routine`.
    2. Set Custom Field: `urgency_level` = `Standard Routine Repair`.
    3. Send Template: `SMS-TRIAGE-ROUTINE-ACK`.
    4. Apply Tag: `triage:step-2-pending`.
    5. Remove Tag: `status:mctb-active`.

* **Intent Group: Unrecognized / Ambiguous**
  * Send Template: `SMS-TRIAGE-CLARIFICATION`.
  * Increment counter `triage_attempts`. If `triage_attempts` > 1, apply `human-takeover` and alert Central Dispatch.

#### Step 2: Address & Property Validation
Once intent is categorized, step 2 captures the property details:
* The engine triggers an address query: `SMS-TRIAGE-LOC-PROMPT`.
* Prospect enters address (e.g., *"4102 Spicewood Springs Rd, Austin"*).
* Bot evaluates ZIP/City against `{{custom_values.service_area_zips}}`.
  * **Match:** Proceed to confirm booking window and route to **Workflow 4**.
  * **No Match / Out of Territory:** Route to Branch Out-of-Zone -> Send `SMS-TRIAGE-OUT-OF-AREA` -> Tag `routing:out-of-service-area`.

---

### Workflow 4: Technician On-Call Escalation & Alert Protocol

Triggered exclusively when a lead is categorized as `status:qualified-emergency` outside normal business hours.

```
[ TRIGGER: Contact Tag Added: status:qualified-emergency ]
  Filter: Outside Business Hours (Mon-Fri < 07:30 or > 18:00, Sat > 14:00, Sunday All Day)
        │
        ▼
[ ACTION: Add Tag: dispatch:pending-tech-ack ]
        │
        ▼
[ ACTION: Outbound Internal SMS to Tier 1 On-Call Tech ]
  Recipient: {{custom_values.tech_on_call_tier1}}
  Message: "EMERGENCY DISPATCH REQUIRED: {{contact.first_name}} at {{contact.address1}} 
            needs immediate service. Issue: {{contact.hvac_system_type}}. 
            Reply 'ACCEPT {{contact.id}}' within 5 minutes to claim."
        │
        ▼
[ WAIT ACTION: 5 Minutes for Incoming SMS from Tier 1 Tech ]
        ├── Path A: Tech Replied "ACCEPT [ID]"
        │     │
        │     ▼
        │   [ Tag: dispatch:tech-assigned ]
        │   [ Send SMS-DISPATCH-CONFIRMED to Customer ]
        │   [ Push Payload to ServiceTitan API /bookings ]
        │
        └── Path B: Timeout (No Reply after 5 minutes)
              │
              ▼
            [ ACTION: Fallback Outbound Call & SMS to Tier 2 Tech ]
            Wait: 5 Minutes
              ├── Path B1: Tech 2 Replied "ACCEPT"
              │     [ Assign Tech 2 & Alert Customer ]
              │
              └── Path B2: Timeout (No Reply after 5 minutes)
                    │
                    ▼
                  [ CRITICAL FAILURE ESCALATION: CALL CHRIS KOEHNE ]
                  - Direct Phone Dial to {{custom_values.owner_emergency_escalation}}
                  - Emergency Whisper: "Critical dispatch failure. Two on-call techs 
                    failed to acknowledge emergency lead {{contact.first_name}}."
                  - Tag: dispatch:escalated-to-owner
```

---

## 3. Production-Ready SMS Copy Templates

All templates conform to Cellular Telecommunications Industry Association (CTIA) guidelines and A2P 10DLC requirements, incorporating company identity, conversational context, and clear opt-out language (`Reply STOP to cancel`).

### Category A: Missed-Call Text-Back (MCTB)

#### `SMS-MCTB-01-BIZ` (Business Hours — Initial Touch)
> "Hi {{contact.first_name | default: 'there'}}, this is Sarah with Apex Comfort Solutions. We missed your call while assisting another Central Texas homeowner! Are you experiencing an urgent heating/cooling issue, or did you need to schedule routine service? Reply directly to this text—I’m standing by to help."

#### `SMS-MCTB-02-AFTERHOURS` (After-Hours Emergency Hook)
> "Hi {{contact.first_name | default: 'there'}}, you reached Apex Comfort Solutions after hours. Our dispatch phone is resting, but our emergency tech team is on call. If your AC or heat is down tonight, reply 'EMERGENCY' with your address, and I will alert our on-call technician immediately."

#### `SMS-MCTB-03-NUDGE` (3-Minute Re-Engagement Follow-Up)
> "Apex Comfort check-in: We know HVAC problems can’t wait in this Texas weather. Reply here anytime tonight if you want us to reserve the earliest emergency dispatch slot for you."

---

### Category B: Digital Lead Speed-to-Lead Responses

#### `SMS-LEAD-01-EMERGENCY` (Instant Response to Web / LSA Emergency Leads)
> "Apex Comfort Solutions Priority Dispatch: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, we received your urgent service request from Google. Is the system completely offline right now, and are there any elderly residents or infants in the home? Reply here so we can prioritize your technician routing."

#### `SMS-LEAD-02-STANDARD` (Instant Response to Routine Repair / Quote Leads)

---

### Category C: Conversational Triage & Qualification

#### `SMS-TRIAGE-EMERGENCY-ACK` (Immediate Confirmation of Urgent Need)
> "Understood. No cooling or heating in our climate is serious. Our on-call trucks carry full diagnostic parts. What is the exact street address and ZIP code for the home, and are you the homeowner?"

#### `SMS-TRIAGE-ROUTINE-ACK` (Routine / Maintenance Confirmation)

#### `SMS-TRIAGE-LOC-PROMPT` (Address Verification Clarification)

#### `SMS-TRIAGE-OUT-OF-AREA` (Polite Disqualification for Non-Serviceable Regions)
> "Thank you for reaching out to Apex Comfort Solutions. It appears your property is located outside our licensed Central Texas service territory. To get you taken care of as fast as possible, we recommend contacting a local HVAC specialist in your county. We apologize for the inconvenience!"

#### `SMS-TRIAGE-CLARIFICATION` (Fallback for Unclear Intent)
> "Thanks for getting back to us. To get you to the right dispatcher, could you let us know: Is your system completely stopped, or are you looking to book a routine repair or system replacement estimate?"

---

### Category D: Technician Escalation & Customer Finalization

#### `SMS-DISPATCH-CONFIRMED` (Customer-Facing Emergency Confirmation)

#### `SMS-TECH-ALERT-DISPATCH` (Internal Dispatch Message to Technician Mobile)
> "🚨 APEX AFTER-HOURS DISPATCH:
> Client: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
> Phone: {{contact.phone}}
> Address: {{contact.address1}}, {{contact.city}}
> Issue: {{contact.urgency_level}} - System: {{contact.hvac_system_type}}
> Access Notes: {{contact.issue_description}}

## 4. Branching Logic Flowchart (Conversational Triage)

```

                                        │

## 5. Failover Routing Rules & Operational Guardrails

To prevent automation runaway, duplicate dispatches, carrier blacklisting, or customer friction, the following operational safeguards are hardcoded into GoHighLevel.

### 5.1 Human-in-the-Loop Override (Dead-Man Switch)
* **Trigger:** Whenever a dispatcher or technician manually sends an SMS or makes an outbound call to the contact directly through GHL Conversational UI or ServiceTitan:
  * Automatically apply the tag: `human-takeover`.
  * Instantly fire an automated action: `Workflow - Remove Contact from ALL Active Workflows`.
  * Set Custom Field: `bot_active` = `False`.
* **Effect:** Prevents automated responses from cutting across a real-time conversation between a technician and a homeowner.

### 5.2 Technician Escalation Failover Matrix

| Tier Level | Target Assignee | Escalation Trigger | Timeout Window | Channel & Redundancy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1** | Primary On-Call Technician | `status:qualified-emergency` applied after-hours | **5 Minutes** (300 seconds) | High-priority SMS with dynamic callback webhook link. |
| **Tier 2** | Secondary Lead Technician | Tier 1 fails to reply `ACCEPT` within 5 minutes | **5 Minutes** (300 seconds) | Automated outbound IVR call + SMS push to mobile device. |
| **Tier 3** | Business Owner (Chris Koehne) | Tier 2 fails to reply `ACCEPT` within 5 minutes | **Immediate** | Direct mobile cell call (Whisper Drop: "Unacknowledged Emergency"). |
| **Dead-Letter** | Dispatch Fallback Channel | Carrier rejection / Twilio SMS delivery failure | **Instantaneous** | Automated Slack/SaneBox high-priority email alert to dispatch team. |

### 5.3 Telecom & Twilio/LC-Phone Error Code Handling
* **Error 30003 / 30005 (Unreachable / Unknown Destination):**
  * The system flags the contact with `flag:invalid-phone`.
  * The engine switches instantly from SMS protocol to **Automated Email Rescue Protocol** (if email is present from Web Form).
  * System alerts dispatcher: *"Customer mobile is unreachable. Attempt voice call or review alternate contact details."*
* **Error 30007 / 30008 (Carrier Violation / Filtered Content):**
  * Immediately pauses outbound automated SMS across the account for that carrier route.
  * System alerts RevOps admin to inspect outbound copy against 10DLC compliance filters.

### 5.4 Lead Deduplication & Flood Controls
* **Rapid-Fire Form Submission:** If a user clicks "Submit" 3 times in 60 seconds on the website, an idempotency check in GHL suppresses duplicate triggers. Only the first submission initializes Workflow 2.
* **Concurrent Inbound Calls:** If a prospect calls while their web form auto-responder is processing, the active call status supersedes digital messaging. The system applies `status:call-in-progress`, pausing text sequences until call resolution.

### 5.5 ServiceTitan Direct Handoff Validation Rule
A contact is **ONLY** permitted to pass through the outbound webhook to ServiceTitan (`/jpm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/bookings`) when the following minimum validation schema is satisfied:
1. `contact.phone` is validated in E.164 format.
2. `contact.address1` and `contact.postal_code` are non-empty.
3. `urgency_level` is populated.
4. Tag `routing:out-of-service-area` is **NOT** present.

If validation fails, the contact is routed to the **GHL Exception Resolution Queue**, alerting the lead dispatcher to collect missing property details manually.

- [ ] **NLP Intent Parsing Test:** Send test inbound text *"My AC is blowing hot air and I have an infant at home."* Verify system assigns `urgency_level` = `Critical Emergency`, bypasses routine queue, and triggers Tier 1 Tech escalation alert within 30 seconds.
- [ ] **Failover Test:** Allow Tier 1 tech timer to expire (5 min). Confirm system rings Tier 2 tech automatically.
- [ ] **ServiceTitan Handshake Test:** Confirm test payload lands cleanly in ServiceTitan Unassigned Booking Queue without triggering 400 Bad Request errors.

# Operational Implementation Guide: After-Hours Emergency Intake & Dispatch Workflow Guardrails
**Client:** Apex Comfort Solutions (Chris Koehne) | Central Texas HVAC  
**Focus Area:** After-Hours Emergency Dispatch, AI Booking Guardrails, Inbox Sanitization  
**Core Objective:** Plug the $22,500/month after-hours revenue leak while enforcing strict "Human-in-the-Loop" (HITL) dispatch safeguards to prevent routing errors, capacity blowouts, and unauthorized truck rolls.

---

## 1. Emergency Triage Decision Matrix

In the Central Texas HVAC market, system outages during extreme ambient conditions pose genuine life-safety, health, and property damage risks. This matrix defines how the GoHighLevel (GHL) conversational engine and after-hours triage workflows categorize incoming issues, establish operational priority, enforce pricing transparency, and interface with ServiceTitan (ST) dispatch queues.

### 1.1 Triage Classification & Parameter Definitions

| Dimension | P1: Critical Emergency | P2: High-Priority Urgent | P3: Routine Service / Maintenance | P4: Out-of-Scope / Non-Serviceable |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Environmental Triggers** | Outdoor Temp $\ge 90^\circ\text{F}$ (or Heat Index $>100^\circ\text{F}$); Hard Freeze conditions ($\le 38^\circ\text{F}$). | Ambient Temp between $75^\circ\text{F}$ and $89^\circ\text{F}$ (moderate heat load); Heating inactive with ambient $>40^\circ\text{F}$. | Weather mild ($65^\circ\text{F}$ to $75^\circ\text{F}$); System functioning but underperforming. | N/A (Outside geographic zone or unsupported equipment). |
| **Occupant / Risk Factors** | Vulnerable occupants (infants $<12\text{mo}$, seniors $>70\text{yo}$, medical conditions dependent on climate control); active burning electrical odor; primary drain pan overflow directly threatening drywall ceilings. | Single-system home with complete outage, no vulnerable occupants; secondary cooling zone operating; minor outdoor unit icing without water leak. | Seasonal tune-up requests; second-opinion quote inquiries; minor noise/vibration; routine filter replacements; cosmetic ductwork issues. | Commercial refrigeration, chillers, non-permitted mobile home package units, or prospects outside verified Central TX zip codes. |
| **Target Response SLA** | Instant text-back $<15\text{s}$; Tech claimed within **10 minutes**; Arrival on-site within **90–120 minutes**. | Instant text-back $<30\text{s}$; Triage finalized $<15\text{min}$; First-available morning slot (08:00–10:00). | Text response $<60\text{s}$; Booked during standard business hours within 24–48 hours. | Immediate automated polite redirect $<60\text{s}$. |
| **Fee Structure & Disclosure** | After-Hours Emergency Dispatch Fee: **$189 diagnostic** (disclosed and agreed via SMS before technician roll). | Standard Diagnostic Fee: **$99** applied to earliest morning route. | Standard Diagnostic Fee: **$99** or seasonal maintenance promo rate. | $0 (No dispatch). |
| **ServiceTitan Job Type & Priority** | `JobTypeId: 204` (Emergency HVAC Diagnostic) | `JobTypeId: 201` (Service Diagnostic - Standard) | `JobTypeId: 202` (Maintenance / Tune-Up) | N/A (Lead logged for marketing attribution, no job created). |
| **Priority Level in ST** | **Urgent (Red Flag)** | **High** | **Normal** | N/A |
| **GHL Tag Taxonomy** | `status:qualified-emergency`, `priority:p1-critical`, `dispatch:pending-tech-ack` | `status:qualified-routine`, `priority:p2-urgent-nextday` | `status:routine-service`, `priority:p3-routine` | `routing:out-of-service-area` or `routing:commercial-unsupported` |

---

### 1.2 Decision Logic & Customer Interaction Matrix

```

[ Hazard / Temp Extreme ]  [ System Down / Temp Mild ]  [ Routine / Tune-up / Out ]

#### P1: Critical Emergency Ruleset
* **AI Conversational Prompt:** *"We detect an emergency outage. Central Texas heat/cold can become unsafe quickly. Our on-call master technician is authorized to roll immediately. Our after-hours diagnostic and safety inspection fee is $189, which is credited toward any major repair. Do you authorize this dispatch fee to secure tonight's emergency slot? (Reply YES or NO)"*
* **Decision Path:**
  * **If YES:** Lock emergency reservation slot $\rightarrow$ Trigger On-Call Escalation Protocol (Section 2) $\rightarrow$ Inject Booking into ServiceTitan marked `URGENT`.
  * **If NO:** De-escalate immediately: *"Understood. We can hold a priority first-arrival slot for you tomorrow morning between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM at our standard $99 diagnostic rate. Would you like me to reserve that now?"*

#### P2: High-Priority Urgent Ruleset
* **AI Conversational Prompt:** *"Thank you for providing those details. Because your home is currently safe and outdoor temperatures are stable tonight, we can dispatch our first morning technician directly to you between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM at our standard diagnostic rate of $99. Shall I lock that morning arrival window in for you?"*
* **Decision Path:**
  * System holds placeholder in the ServiceTitan Dispatch Board for 08:00 next business day.
  * No technician is woken up; lead dispatcher handles final assignment at 07:00 AM during morning board scrubbing.

---

## 2. On-Call Escalation Protocol Documentation & Dispatcher Workflow Guardrails

To prevent "runaway automation" (e.g., an AI bot hard-booking a 2:00 AM truck roll when the on-call technician is already finishing an active emergency or out of legal drive hours), Apex Comfort Solutions enforces a strict **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)** architecture.

```
       [ GHL Conversational AI ]
       (Emergency Fee Accepted)
                   │
                   ▼
       [ Create GHL Provisional Hold ]
       (Capacity Slot Reserved: 1 of 2)
                   │
                   ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              TIER 1: PRIMARY ON-CALL TECHNICIAN                 │
│  - Dispatch Alert via SMS + Deep Link Push                     │
│  - SLA Countdown: 5 Minutes (300 Seconds)                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                   │
        ┌──────────┴──────────┐
        ▼                     ▼
  [ Tech Acknowledges ]    [ Timeout: 5 Min ]
        │                     │
        │                     ▼
        │        ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │        │      TIER 2: SECONDARY BACKUP TECHNICIAN       │
        │        │  - Automated Voice Dial (Twilio Whisper Drop)  │
        │        │  - Outbound High-Priority SMS                  │
        │        │  - SLA Countdown: 5 Minutes (300 Seconds)      │
        │        └────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
        │                             │
        │                  ┌──────────┴──────────┐
        │                  ▼                     ▼
        │            [ Tech 2 Acks ]       [ Timeout: 5 Min ]
        │                  │                     │
        │                  │                     ▼
        │                  │        ┌─────────────────────────────┐
        │                  │        │  TIER 3: CRITICAL OVERRIDE  │
        │                  │        │   Owner (Chris Koehne)      │
        │                  │        │  - Continuous Mobile Ring   │
        │                  │        │  - Fail-Safe Manual Control │
        │                  │        └─────────────────────────────┘
        │                  │                     │
        ▼                  ▼                     ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              DISPATCH FINALIZATION & ST BOOKING                 │
│  - ST API: POST /jpm/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/bookings              │
│  - Push GHL Contact Tag: dispatch:tech-assigned                 │
│  - Outbound SMS to Homeowner: Arrival ETAs & Tech Card Profile  │
│  - Human Takes Ownership (Automation Detaches)                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 2.1 On-Call Capacity Management Engine
* **Max Shift Limit:** The on-call technician is capped at a maximum of **2 after-hours on-site dispatches per night** (Window: 18:00 to 00:00).
  * Slot Alpha: 18:30 – 21:00
  * Slot Beta: 21:00 – 23:30
* **Hard Cut-off (00:00 – 06:30):** No physical truck rolls are dispatched between midnight and 6:30 AM unless categorized as an extraordinary life-safety hazard explicitly authorized by Chris Koehne. Leads arriving between 00:00 and 06:30 are captured, emergency fees quoted if requested, and reserved for **"Priority Early Roll" (07:00 AM)**.
* **Capacity Guardrail:** Once Slot Alpha and Slot Beta are marked `Claimed`, the GHL engine transitions to "Capacity Standby Mode":
  * Auto-response: *"Our on-call emergency team is currently deployed on active life-safety calls across Central Texas. Our next available rapid-response window begins at 7:00 AM. I have reserved your position at the front of our morning queue."*

---

### 2.2 Tiered Escalation Chain Specifications

#### Tier 1: Primary On-Call Technician
* **Trigger:** Contact flagged `status:qualified-emergency` AND fee accepted between 18:00 and 23:59.
* **Communication Channel:** High-Priority Twilio SMS + ServiceTitan Mobile In-App Notification.
* **Timeout Clock:** **5 Minutes (300 Seconds)**.
* **Payload Script (SMS to Tech):**
  ```text
  🚨 APEX AFTER-HOURS DISPATCH ALERT
  Ticket: Marcus Vance | Austin, TX 78759
  System: Heat Pump / Burning Smell / Infant in Home
  Fee: $189 Approved | Capacity Slot: 1 of 2
  Action: Reply '1' or click https://app.apexcomfort.com/claim?id=ghl_982347 within 5 mins to claim.
  ```

#### Tier 2: Secondary / Backup Technician
* **Trigger:** Tier 1 timeout expires without positive acknowledgment (`1` or link-click).
* **Communication Channel:** Direct Phone Dial via Twilio Voice API (Whisper Drop) + Parallel Urgent SMS.
* **Twilio Voice Whisper Script:**
  ```text
  "This is the Apex Comfort Automated Dispatch System. Primary technician has failed to acknowledge an emergency service request for an HVAC failure in Austin. Press 1 immediately to accept this dispatch and receive customer details, or press 9 to reject."
  ```
* **Timeout Clock:** **5 Minutes (300 Seconds)**.

#### Tier 3: Critical Owner Escalation (Chris Koehne)
* **Trigger:** Both Tier 1 and Tier 2 technicians fail to acknowledge within an aggregate of 10 minutes.
* **Communication Channel:** Direct cellular phone call with bypass of "Do Not Disturb" (via repetitive Twilio ring pattern) + Urgent SMS + SaneBox Emergency Email push.
* **Script / Action:**
  * System alerts Chris Koehne: *"ESCALATION CRITICAL: Unassigned after-hours emergency at 4102 Spicewood Springs Rd. Tech 1 and Tech 2 failed to respond. Immediate intervention required."*
  * Chris has single-click options to:
    1. Force-assign to a designated tech via voice prompt.
    2. Click to call customer immediately via bridge.
    3. Re-route to preferred third-party emergency contractor partner.

---

### 2.3 The "Human-in-the-Loop" Dead-Man Override Mechanism

To eliminate the risk of automated bots conflicting with human technicians who are actively communicating with a customer:

1. **Active Communication Takeover:**
   * If any Apex technician or dispatcher initiates an outbound phone call or sends an outbound SMS to the customer via the ServiceTitan dialer or GHL mobile app, the webhook catches the `outbound_communication` event.
   * **Automated System Response:**
     * Applies tag: `human-takeover`.
     * Sets custom field: `bot_active` = `FALSE`.
     * Instantly ejects the contact from all conversational triage and follow-up nurture sequences.
2. **Drive-Time and Geographic Feasibility Safeguards:**
   * Automated dispatches will not assign a technician whose last completed job or home base is $>35\text{ miles}$ away from the target property, avoiding dangerous driver fatigue and missed SLAs.
   * If travel time exceeds 45 minutes according to live routing APIs, the booking is automatically flagged with: `flag:extended-transit-notice`.
   * An SMS is triggered to the customer setting realistic expectations: *"Your technician is en route from our southern sector. Due to distance, estimated arrival time is [ETA + 15 mins]."*

---

## 3. Dispatcher Email Inbox Sanitization Ruleset (SaneBox Deployment)

Apex Comfort Solutions dispatchers spend 5 to 10 hours weekly manually wading through hundreds of daily emails—sorting vendor parts catalogs, warranty receipts, and marketing solicitations to find urgent customer cancellation updates, after-hours voicemails, and inspection failures.

Deploying SaneBox eliminates this operational drag, establishing a deterministic, rule-based filtering architecture directly at the IMAP/Exchange level.

### 3.1 Folder Topology & Storage Structure

```
[ INBOUND DISPATCH INBOX (dispatch@apexcomfort.com) ]
                          │
       ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────┐
       ▼                  ▼                  ▼
┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────────┐
│  @SaneUrgent │   │   @SaneLater │   │ @SaneNews /  │
│  (VIP / ST)  │   │  (Vendors)   │   │  BlackHole   │
└──────────────┘   └──────────────┘   └──────────────┘
```

* **`INBOX` (Zero-Noise Core):** Contains exclusively high-priority, real-time items requiring action within $\le 30\text{ minutes}$.
* **`@SaneUrgentDispatch` (Custom VIP Subfolder):** Immediate webhook drop alerts, Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) integration errors, and after-hours critical notifications.
* **`@SaneLater`:** Low-priority routine communications (e.g., standard supply receipts, distributor price adjustment bulletins, non-urgent customer inquiries). Reviewed twice daily (11:30 AM and 3:30 PM).
* **`@SaneNews`:** Marketing digests, HVAC manufacturer promotional updates (Trane, Carrier, Lennox newsletters), trade associations.
* **`@SaneBlackHole`:** One-way purge for un-unsubscribable spam, cold sales pitches to Chris Koehne, and irrelevant vendor solicitations.
* **`@SaneReminders`:** Follow-up tracking folder for pending warranty credits and back-ordered parts.

---

### 3.2 Deterministic SaneBox Filtering Ruleset

#### Rule Profile 1: Tier-0 Emergency & Integration Monitoring (Route to `INBOX` & Force Mobile Chime)
* **Match Condition:**
  * **Sender Contains:** `alerts@servicetitan.com`, `dlq-monitor@apexcomfort.com`, `twilio.com`, `google-lsa-noreply@google.com`
  * **OR Subject Contains:** `[EMERGENCY DISPATCH]`, `CRITICAL DLQ`, `Carrier Filter Alert (10DLC)`, `Unassigned After-Hours Lead`
* **SaneBox Action:** Pin to top of `INBOX`. Never move to `@SaneLater`.
* **Execution:** System triggers desktop push notification and rings Central Dispatch workstation chime.

#### Rule Profile 2: Customer Cancellations & Real-Time Reschedules (Route to `INBOX`)
* **Match Condition:**
  * **Subject Contains:** `Cancel`, `Cancellation`, `Reschedule`, `Running late`, `Emergency`, `Leak`, `Carbon Monoxide`, `Gas smell`
  * **AND Sender Does NOT Contain:** `newsletter`, `promotions`, `billing@`, `invoices@`
* **SaneBox Action:** Retain in `INBOX`. Flag as High Importance (Red Star).

#### Rule Profile 3: Commercial Vendor & Supply House Operational Traffic (Route to `@SaneLater`)
* **Match Condition:**
  * **Sender Domain Equals:** `insco.com`, `johnstonesupply.com`, `carrierenterprise.com`, `ferguson.com`, `dakota-supply.com`
  * **AND Subject Does NOT Contain:** `Emergency PO`, `Expedited Part Confirmation`, `Backorder Shipped`
* **SaneBox Action:** Move automatically to `@SaneLater`.
* **Daily Management:** Aggregated in the 11:30 AM dispatcher daily briefing summary. Prevents dispatchers from being distracted while actively managing the live board.

#### Rule Profile 4: Marketing Spam, Scrap Metal Buyers, & Unsolicited Vendor Pitches (Route to `@SaneBlackHole`)
* **Match Condition:**
  * **Subject Contains:** `SEO ranking`, `Lead generation partner`, `Grow your HVAC business`, `Exclusive commercial leads`, `Virtual assistant solutions`
  * **AND Sender Domain NOT In:** Customer whitelist or active vendor list.
  * **SaneBox Action:** Move directly to `@SaneBlackHole`. Future emails from these senders silently discarded without notification.

---

### 3.3 SaneBox Implementation & Training Matrix

| Filter Stream / Folder | Senders & Patterns | Action / Priority | Training Mechanism | Target Time Saved |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`@SaneUrgentDispatch`** | GHL Middleware DLQ alerts, Google LSA Direct Message notifications, ST Webhook failures | Delivered to `INBOX` instantly; alerts dispatched to Chris Koehne's phone. | Whitelist domains: `*.servicetitan.com`, `api.gohighlevel.com`. Train via custom SaneBox subject rule: `[URGENT]`. | 1.5 hrs/wk (Instant incident awareness) |
| **`INBOX` (Sanitized)** | Direct customer emails, warranty approvals from distributor reps, permit approvals from City of Austin / Williamson County. | Remained in main inbox. Triggers normal dispatch queue review. | Drag-and-drop manual training during Day 2 onboarding; AI learns patterns within 24 hours. | 2.5 hrs/wk (Context switching eliminated) |
| **`@SaneLater`** | Johnstone Supply, Insco, Ferguson invoices, standard parts statements, non-urgent warranty documentation. | Swept out of view. Processed during scheduled admin blocks (11:30 AM, 3:30 PM). | Bulk drag vendor billing domains to `@SaneLater` during Day 2 config. | 4.0 hrs/wk (Batched email processing) |
| **`@SaneBlackHole`** | Unsolicited marketing vendors, offshore dispatch agencies, digital marketing agencies, SaaS cold outreach. | Auto-deleted; never seen by human staff. | Send unwanted solicitations to `blackhole@sanebox.com`. SaneBox creates perpetual block rule. | 2.0 hrs/wk (Manual inbox purge eliminated) |

---

## 4. End-to-End Operational Execution Walkthrough (A Real-World Central Texas Scenario)

To illustrate how these guardrails interlock seamlessly in the field, here is the chronological workflow of an after-hours breakdown:

```
20:14:15 CT  Inbound Call to Apex Tracking Number (Google LSA).
             Outdoor temperature in Round Rock: 96°F.
             Central Dispatch desk is closed. Call rings 4 times -> No-Answer.

20:14:30 CT  GoHighLevel executes Workflow 1 (MCTB Engine) after exact 15-second delay.
             Outbound SMS sent to customer:
             "Hi Marcus, this is Apex Comfort Solutions. We saw we just missed your call!
             Central Texas heat doesn't wait—are you experiencing an AC emergency right now?"

20:15:10 CT  Customer Marcus Vance replies:
             "Yes! System completely shut off, blowing warm air, and my 6-month-old baby
             is in the house. It's already 82 degrees inside."

20:15:12 CT  Triage Decision Matrix triggers:
             - Matches Keywords: 'warm air', 'baby'.
             - Matches Ambient Condition: > 90°F.
             - System Classifies: Priority 1 (Critical Emergency).
             - Sets Custom Field: urgency_level = "Critical Emergency".

20:15:25 CT  GoHighLevel sends Emergency Triage Fee Script:
             "Understood, Marcus. With an infant in the home and 96° heat, this is an 
             immediate priority. Our on-call master tech is available. Our after-hours 
             diagnostic fee is $189, credited toward major repairs. Do you authorize this 
             dispatch fee? (Reply YES or NO)"

20:15:50 CT  Marcus Vance replies: "YES, please hurry."

20:15:52 CT  Automated Capacity Guardrail validates:
             - On-Call Tech capacity: 0 of 2 slots filled.
             - Address validated: Round Rock, TX (Within Service Area Zip 78681).
             - Creates ServiceTitan Booking (Status: Open, Priority: Urgent).
             - Applies GHL Tag: status:qualified-emergency.

20:16:00 CT  Escalation Chain activates:
             - Tier 1 SMS dispatched to Primary Tech Dave's mobile.
             - 300-second countdown initiates.

20:18:42 CT  Tech Dave replies: "1" (Claimed).
             - Escalation loop terminates (Tier 2/3 suppressed).
             - Tag applied: dispatch:tech-assigned.
             - System sends customer SMS-DISPATCH-CONFIRMED with Tech Dave's photo link.

20:19:15 CT  Tech Dave clicks the ServiceTitan dialer on his phone to call Marcus directly.
             - HITL Safeguard detects outbound technician communication.
             - Tag applied: human-takeover.
             - Automated bot disengages completely. Human ownership established in under 5 minutes.
```

---

## 5. Implementation & Verification Sign-Off Checklist (Wednesday Dispatch Desk Integration)

- [ ] **SaneBox Deployment & Authorization:**
  - Connect `dispatch@apexcomfort.com` and `chris@apexcomfort.com` to SaneBox via OAuth/Exchange.

  - Verify non-urgent vendor domains are routed to `@SaneLater`.

  - Verify ServiceTitan On-Call Shift schedule reflects primary and secondary technician rotations for Central Texas coverage.

  - Validate after-hours capacity limit rule (Maximum 2 dispatches before automated diversion to Priority Morning queue).
- [ ] **Conversational Triage Stress Testing:**

  - Execute test scenario 2: Simulate ambient $72^\circ\text{F}$ maintenance request $\rightarrow$ Verify P3 Routine classification and de-escalation to next-business-day self-scheduling link.
  - Execute test scenario 3: Simulate out-of-territory address (e.g., San Antonio zip code 78201) $\rightarrow$ Verify polite disqualification script and tagging with zero ServiceTitan booking pollution.
- [ ] **Failover & HITL Guardrail Testing:**
  - Simulate Tier 1 Tech non-response: Verify system holds for exactly 300 seconds, fails over to Tier 2 phone call/whisper, and notifies Chris Koehne if Tier 2 fails.
  - Initiate outbound call from ServiceTitan mobile app to test lead $\rightarrow$ Verify tag `human-takeover` is immediately added and the GHL conversational engine pauses instantly.

# Operational Intelligence & KPI Performance Dashboard Setup
**Client:** Apex Comfort Solutions (Chris Koehne) | Central Texas HVAC  
**Target Focus:** DashThis KPI Dashboard Architecture, Marketing Attribution, Speed-to-Lead SLA Monitoring, and Revenue Leakage Recovery Tracking  
**Baseline Risk:** $37,500/mo ($450,000/yr) Revenue Leakage  
**Tech Stack:** DashThis, Google Local Services Ads (LSA), GoHighLevel (v2 REST API / Webhooks), ServiceTitan (v2 API / Reporting Tables), Google Sheets Middleware / BigQuery Sink.

---

## 1. DashThis Data Architecture & Integration Schema

To consolidate disparate field-service marketing channels, conversational automation streams, and dispatch ERP records into a real-time single source of truth, DashThis is architected via native connectors and custom API/CSV middleware pipelines.

```
┌────────────────────────┐      ┌────────────────────────┐      ┌────────────────────────┐
│  Google LSA Direct API │      │  GoHighLevel (GHL API) │      │ ServiceTitan (ST API)  │
│  - Ad Spend            │      │  - First-Touch Timers  │      │  - Estimates Delivered │
│  - Charged Leads       │      │  - Inbound Messages    │      │  - Estimates Sold ($)  │
│  - Dispute Credits     │      │  - SLA Compliance Logs │      │  - Dispatch Times      │
└───────────┬────────────┘      └───────────┬────────────┘      └───────────┬────────────┘
            │                               │                               │
            │ Native Connector              │ Webhook / Lambda Ingestion     │ Scheduled Extraction
            ▼                               ▼                               ▼
    ┌───────────────┐              ┌──────────────────┐            ┌──────────────────┐
    │ DashThis LSA  │              │ BigQuery / Cloud │            │ ServiceTitan BI  │
    │  Data Feed    │              │  Sheets Data Hub │            │ Export Pipeline  │
    └───────┬───────┘              └───────┬─────────┘            └───────┬──────────┘
            │                               │                               │
            └───────────────────────┬───────┴───────────────────────────────┘
                                    │ Custom CSV / API Integration
                                    ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                 DASHTHIS DASHBOARD ENGINE                              │
│                                                                                        │
│   ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ VIEW 1: Executive Revenue & Leakage    │  │ VIEW 2: Dispatcher Operational     │   │
│   │ (Chris Koehne — Strategic Focus)       │  │ (Lead Dispatch Desk — SLA Focus)   │   │
│   └────────────────────────────────────────┘  └────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 1.1 Data Source Ingestion Pipelines

| Data Source | Connection Method | Data Frequency | Ingestion Payload / Key Metrics |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Google Local Services Ads (LSA)** | DashThis Native Google Ads / LSA Connector | Hourly sync (API v16) | `Cost`, `Impressions`, `Phone Leads`, `Message Leads`, `Charged Leads`, `Disputed/Credited Leads` |
| **GoHighLevel (GHL)** | GHL Custom API / Zapier Webhook to DashThis CSV Engine | Real-time events batch-aggregated every 15 min | `contact_id`, `inbound_timestamp`, `first_response_timestamp`, `response_delta_seconds`, `source_tag`, `triage_status` |
| **ServiceTitan (ST)** | ST Enterprise v2 API (`/jpm/v2/`, `/accounting/v2/`) via JSON Webhook | Hourly batch sync (Rollup daily at 23:59 CST) | `estimate_id`, `estimate_total`, `estimate_status`, `job_type`, `created_date`, `sold_date`, `technician_id` |
| **Blended Derived Layer** | Google Sheets Middleware (Calculated Engine) | Real-time refresh | Recovery equations, blended CAC, speed-to-lead distributions, lost-revenue delta against baseline |

---

## 2. Metric Definitions & Mathematical Formula Dictionary

Every metric tracked within the system is rigorously defined with exact computational formulas to eliminate ambiguity and guarantee direct marketing attribution to field revenue.

### 2.1 Marketing & Acquisition Attribution

#### 1. Google LSA Ad Spend
* **Code Identifier:** `MKT_LSA_SPEND`
* **Definition:** Gross advertising capital expended within Google Local Services Ads platform during the reporting period, net of approved carrier disputes and bogus lead refunds.
* **Formula:**  
  $$\text{LSA Net Spend} = \sum (\text{Gross LSA Billed Lead Charges}) - \sum (\text{Approved Dispute Credits})$$
* **Aggregation:** Daily, Weekly, Monthly.

#### 2. Cost Per Lead (CPL) – LSA
* **Code Identifier:** `MKT_LSA_CPL`
* **Definition:** Average advertising acquisition cost per raw inbound phone call or message lead generated via Google LSA.
* **Formula:**  
  $$\text{LSA CPL} = \frac{\text{LSA Net Spend}}{\text{Total Qualified LSA Inbound Contacts (Calls} \ge 30\text{s} + \text{Valid Messages)}}$$
* **Benchmark SLA:** $\le \$85.00$ per valid emergency lead in the Central Texas HVAC market.

#### 3. Lead-to-Booked Job Rate
* **Code Identifier:** `OPS_LEAD_BOOK_RATE`
* **Definition:** Percentage of inbound qualified leads (across all sources) that result in a scheduled, dispatched service ticket in ServiceTitan.
* **Formula:**  
  $$\text{Booking Rate (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{Total Booked Service Calls (ST)}}{\text{Total Inbound Qualified Leads (GHL + LSA)}} \right) \times 100$$
* **Benchmark Target:** $\ge 75\%$ for business hours; $\ge 55\%$ for after-hours emergency calls.

---

### 2.2 Speed-to-Lead & SLA Compliance Metrics

#### 4. Speed-to-Lead Response Time (Seconds)
* **Code Identifier:** `SLA_RESP_TIME_SEC`
* **Definition:** The exact duration in elapsed seconds from the receipt of an inbound prospect touchpoint (voice hangup, missed call, web-form submit, or LSA message) to the initial outbound automated response (SMS or voice drop).
* **Formula:**  
  $$\Delta T_{\text{response}} = T_{\text{First Outbound Touch (GHL)}} - T_{\text{Lead Inbound Creation}}$$
* **Operational Goal:**  
  $$\Delta T_{\text{response}} < 60\text{ seconds (Target: } \le 15\text{s for MCTB; } \le 30\text{s for Web Forms)}$$

#### 5. Speed-to-Lead SLA Compliance Rate (< 5 Minutes)
* **Code Identifier:** `SLA_COMPLIANCE_PCT`
* **Definition:** The proportion of all inbound leads contacted and placed into conversational triage within the contractual 5-minute (300-second) performance threshold.
* **Formula:**  
  $$\text{SLA Compliance (\%)} = \left( \frac{\text{Count of Leads with } \Delta T_{\text{response}} \le 300\text{s}}{\text{Total Inbound Leads Received}} \right) \times 100$$
* **Acceptable Floor:** $98.0\%$.

#### 6. Emergency Dispatch Acknowledgment Time
* **Code Identifier:** `SLA_TECH_ACK_SEC`
* **Definition:** The elapsed time between GHL identifying a `status:qualified-emergency` lead after hours and an on-call field technician texting `ACCEPT` to secure dispatch.
* **Formula:**  
  $$\Delta T_{\text{tech\_ack}} = T_{\text{Tech SMS Accept}} - T_{\text{Emergency Tag Applied}}$$
* **Escalation Threshold:** If $\Delta T_{\text{tech\_ack}} > 300\text{s}$ (5 minutes), trigger Tier 2 secondary tech; if $> 600\text{s}$, trigger direct ring to Chris Koehne.
